name: Philip
description: One of Antiochus's friends, made ruler over all his realm and charged to bring up his son Antiochus for the kingdom; returned out of Persia and Media seeking to rule the kingdom, and was defeated and taken by the king at Antioch

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
